name: How do extreme weather conditions in DFW impact roof repair versus replacement decisions?

mainEntity.name: How do extreme weather conditions in DFW impact roof repair versus replacement decisions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Extreme weather in the DFW area, including hailstorms, strong winds, and heavy rain, significantly impacts roof repair versus replacement decisions. Hail damage can sometimes be repaired if localized, but widespread impact often necessitates replacement due to granule loss and weakened shingle integrity. High winds can lift or remove entire sections of shingles, making replacement more likely if damage is extensive across the roof. Our assessments prioritize restoring your roof's ability to withstand future local weather challenges.
acceptedAnswer.description: DFW's extreme weather, like hail and strong winds, can turn repairable damage into replacement needs, especially if widespread.
